Usage: python scripts/eval_d066_scierc.py --input_path <output.jsonl> [--label <name>] [--output_json <path>]
Computes: ET%, RV%, DR%, CF%, Entity F1, Relation F1, Parse Fail%, avg inference time
"""
import json
import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ONTOLOGY_FILE = "/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/ontology_constraints.json"

def normalize_etype(raw):
    return raw.strip()

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--input_path", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--label", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--output_json", default="")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    with open(ONTOLOGY_FILE) as f:
        ontology = json.load(f)

    VALID_ENTITY_TYPES = set(ontology["entity_types"])
    VALID_RELATION_NAMES = set(r.lower().strip() for r in ontology["relation_types"])
    RELATION_CONSTRAINTS = ontology["relation_constraints"]

    valid_pairs_by_rel = {}
    for rel_name, constraint in RELATION_CONSTRAINTS.items():
        valid_pairs_by_rel[rel_name.lower().strip()] = set(tuple(p) for p in constraint["valid_pairs"])

    total_samples = 0
    parse_failures = 0
    total_entities_pred = 0
    total_relations_pred = 0
    et_violations = 0
    rv_violations = 0
    dr_violations = 0
    cf_violations = 0

    entity_tp = entity_fp = entity_fn = 0
    relation_tp = relation_fp = relation_fn = 0
    total_time = 0.0
    time_count = 0

    with open(args.input_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            total_samples += 1
            doc = json.loads(line)
            parsed = doc.get("parsed_output")
            gold_entities = doc.get("gold_entities", [])
            gold_relations = doc.get("gold_relations", [])

            t = doc.get("inference_time_seconds", 0)
            if t:
                total_time += t
                time_count += 1

            if parsed is None or parsed == {}:
                parse_failures += 1
                entity_fn += len(set((e["text"], e["type"]) for e in gold_entities))
                relation_fn += len(set((r["head"], r["tail"], r["type"].lower().strip()) for r in gold_relations))
                continue

            pred_entities = parsed.get("entities", [])
            pred_relations = parsed.get("relations", [])
            total_entities_pred += len(pred_entities)
            total_relations_pred += len(pred_relations)

            for ent in pred_entities:
                if normalize_etype(ent.get("type", "")) not in VALID_ENTITY_TYPES:
                    et_violations += 1

            entity_type_map = defaultdict(set)
            for rel in pred_relations:
                rel_name = rel.get("type", "").lower().strip()
                head_type = normalize_etype(rel.get("head_type", ""))
                tail_type = normalize_etype(rel.get("tail_type", ""))

                if rel.get("head") and head_type:
                    entity_type_map[rel["head"].lower()].add(head_type)
                if rel.get("tail") and tail_type:
                    entity_type_map[rel["tail"].lower()].add(tail_type)

                if rel_name not in VALID_RELATION_NAMES:
                    rv_violations += 1
                    continue

                if rel_name in valid_pairs_by_rel:
                    pair = (head_type, tail_type)
                    if pair not in valid_pairs_by_rel[rel_name]:
                        dr_violations += 1

            for entity_name, types in entity_type_map.items():
                if len(types) > 1:
                    cf_violations += 1

            gold_ent_set = set((e["text"], e["type"]) for e in gold_entities)
            pred_ent_set = set((e["text"], e["type"]) for e in pred_entities)
            entity_tp += len(gold_ent_set & pred_ent_set)
            entity_fp += len(pred_ent_set - gold_ent_set)
            entity_fn += len(gold_ent_set - pred_ent_set)

            gold_rel_set = set()
            for r in gold_relations:
                gold_rel_set.add((r["head"], r["tail"], r["type"].lower().strip()))
            pred_rel_set = set()
            for r in pred_relations:
                pred_rel_set.add((r.get("head",""), r.get("tail",""), r.get("type","").lower().strip()))
            relation_tp += len(gold_rel_set & pred_rel_set)
            relation_fp += len(pred_rel_set - gold_rel_set)
            relation_fn += len(gold_rel_set - pred_rel_set)

    def prf(tp, fp, fn):
        p = tp / (tp + fp) * 100 if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0.0
        r = tp / (tp + fn) * 100 if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0.0
        f1 = 2 * p * r / (p + r) if (p + r) > 0 else 0.0
        return p, r, f1

    e_p, e_r, e_f1 = prf(entity_tp, entity_fp, entity_fn)
    r_p, r_r, r_f1 = prf(relation_tp, relation_fp, relation_fn)

    pf_pct = parse_failures / total_samples * 100 if total_samples else 0
    et_pct = et_violations / total_entities_pred * 100 if total_entities_pred else 0
    rv_pct = rv_violations / total_relations_pred * 100 if total_relations_pred else 0
    dr_pct = dr_violations / total_relations_pred * 100 if total_relations_pred else 0
    cf_pct = cf_violations / total_entities_pred * 100 if total_entities_pred else 0
    avg_time = total_time / time_count if time_count else 0

    label = args.label or Path(args.input_path).stem
    results = {
        "label": label,
        "total_samples": total_samples,
        "parse_failures": parse_failures, "parse_fail_pct": round(pf_pct, 2),
        "total_entities_pred": total_entities_pred,
        "total_relations_pred": total_relations_pred,
        "ET_pct": round(et_pct, 2), "RV_pct": round(rv_pct, 2),
        "DR_pct": round(dr_pct, 2), "CF_pct": round(cf_pct, 2),
        "E_P": round(e_p, 2), "E_R": round(e_r, 2), "E_F1": round(e_f1, 2),
        "R_P": round(r_p, 2), "R_R": round(r_r, 2), "R_F1": round(r_f1, 2),
        "et_violations": et_violations, "rv_violations": rv_violations,
        "dr_violations": dr_violations, "cf_violations": cf_violations,
        "avg_inference_time": round(avg_time, 3),
        "total_inference_time": round(total_time, 1),
    }

    print(f"\n=== {label} ===")

import json
from collections import defaultdict

ONTOLOGY_FILE = 'ontology_constraints.json'
INPUT = 'outputs/prompt_sensitivity_70b/minimal_unconstrained.jsonl'

with open(ONTOLOGY_FILE) as f:
    ontology = json.load(f)

VALID_ENTITY_TYPES = set(ontology['entity_types'])
VALID_RELATION_NAMES = set(r.lower().strip() for r in ontology['relation_types'])
RELATION_CONSTRAINTS = ontology['relation_constraints']
valid_pairs_by_rel = {}
for rel_name, constraint in RELATION_CONSTRAINTS.items():
    valid_pairs_by_rel[rel_name.lower().strip()] = set(tuple(p) for p in constraint['valid_pairs'])

total_samples = 0
parse_failures = 0
total_entities_pred = 0
total_relations_pred = 0
et_violations = rv_violations = dr_violations = cf_violations = 0
entity_tp = entity_fp = entity_fn = 0
relation_tp = relation_fp = relation_fn = 0
total_time = 0.0
time_count = 0

def safe_str(v):
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return str(v)
    return str(v) if v else ''

with open(INPUT) as f:
    for line in f:
        total_samples += 1
        doc = json.loads(line)
        parsed = doc.get('parsed_output')
        gold_entities = doc.get('gold_entities', [])
        gold_relations = doc.get('gold_relations', [])
        t = doc.get('inference_time_seconds', 0)
        if t:
            total_time += t
            time_count += 1
        if parsed is None or parsed == {}:
            parse_failures += 1
            entity_fn += len(set((e['text'], e['type']) for e in gold_entities))
            relation_fn += len(set((r['head'], r['tail'], r['type'].lower().strip()) for r in gold_relations))
            continue
        pred_entities = parsed.get('entities', [])
        pred_relations = parsed.get('relations', [])
        total_entities_pred += len(pred_entities)
        total_relations_pred += len(pred_relations)
        for ent in pred_entities:
            if ent.get('type', '').strip() not in VALID_ENTITY_TYPES:
                et_violations += 1
        entity_type_map = defaultdict(set)
        for rel in pred_relations:
            rel_name = safe_str(rel.get('type', '')).lower().strip()
            head_type = safe_str(rel.get('head_type', '')).strip()
            tail_type = safe_str(rel.get('tail_type', '')).strip()
            h = safe_str(rel.get('head', ''))
            tl = safe_str(rel.get('tail', ''))
            if h and head_type:
                entity_type_map[h.lower()].add(head_type)
            if tl and tail_type:
                entity_type_map[tl.lower()].add(tail_type)
            if rel_name not in VALID_RELATION_NAMES:
                rv_violations += 1
                continue
            if rel_name in valid_pairs_by_rel:
                pair = (head_type, tail_type)
                if pair not in valid_pairs_by_rel[rel_name]:
                    dr_violations += 1
        for entity_name, types in entity_type_map.items():
            if len(types) > 1:
                cf_violations += 1
        gold_ent_set = set((e['text'], e['type']) for e in gold_entities)
        pred_ent_set = set((safe_str(e.get('text','')), safe_str(e.get('type',''))) for e in pred_entities)
        entity_tp += len(gold_ent_set & pred_ent_set)
        entity_fp += len(pred_ent_set - gold_ent_set)
        entity_fn += len(gold_ent_set - pred_ent_set)
        gold_rel_set = set((r['head'], r['tail'], r['type'].lower().strip()) for r in gold_relations)
        pred_rel_set = set()
        for r in pred_relations:
            h = safe_str(r.get('head',''))
            tl = safe_str(r.get('tail',''))
            tp = safe_str(r.get('type','')).lower().strip()
            pred_rel_set.add((h, tl, tp))
        relation_tp += len(gold_rel_set & pred_rel_set)
        relation_fp += len(pred_rel_set - gold_rel_set)
        relation_fn += len(gold_rel_set - pred_rel_set)

def prf(tp, fp, fn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp) * 100 if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0.0
    r = tp / (tp + fn) * 100 if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0.0
    f1 = 2 * p * r / (p + r) if (p + r) > 0 else 0.0
    return p, r, f1

e_p, e_r, e_f1 = prf(entity_tp, entity_fp, entity_fn)
r_p, r_r, r_f1 = prf(relation_tp, relation_fp, relation_fn)
et_pct = et_violations / total_entities_pred * 100 if total_entities_pred else 0
rv_pct = rv_violations / total_relations_pred * 100 if total_relations_pred else 0
dr_pct = dr_violations / total_relations_pred * 100 if total_relations_pred else 0
cf_pct = cf_violations / total_entities_pred * 100 if total_entities_pred else 0
avg_time = total_time / time_count if time_count else 0

print(f'=== minimal/unconstrained ===')
print(f'Samples: {total_samples}, Parse Fail: {parse_failures} ({parse_failures/total_samples*100:.1f}%)')
print(f'Entities pred: {total_entities_pred}, Relations pred: {total_relations_pred}')
print(f'ET%={et_pct:.2f}  RV%={rv_pct:.2f}  DR%={dr_pct:.2f}  CF%={cf_pct:.2f}')
print(f'E-F1={e_f1:.2f} (P={e_p:.2f} R={e_r:.2f})')
print(f'R-F1={r_f1:.2f} (P={r_p:.2f} R={r_r:.2f})')
print(f'Avg inference time: {avg_time:.3f}s, Total: {total_time:.1f}s')

        for entity_name, types in entity_type_map.items():

I can see the issue. In the minimal/unconstrained output, the model outputs relations in a different format:
```json
{
  "type": "Used-for",
  "head": {"text": "approach", "type": "Method"},
  "tail": {"text": "Multi-lingual Evaluation Task", "type": "Task"}
}
```

Instead of the expected flat format:
```json
{
  "head": "approach", "tail": "...", "type": "Used-for", "head_type": "Method", "tail_type": "Task"
}
```

The head and tail fields are dicts with `text` and `type` sub-fields, not strings. 

The minimal prompt doesn't enforce a specific output format, so the model naturally chose a nested structure instead of the flat format that the constrained grammar enforces. This is a critical insight for the prompt sensitivity study—the 94.12% DR% is actually measuring format incompatibility rather than genuine domain violations, which makes that metric misleading.

I need to build an evaluation function that can handle both the nested and flat relation formats properly, so I can compute the actual DR% while also documenting that the minimal/unconstrained approach produces structurally different output.

"""Evaluate prompt sensitivity outputs, handling both flat and nested relation formats."""
import json
from collections import defaultdict

ONTOLOGY_FILE = '/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/ontology_constraints.json'
OUTPUT_DIR = '/root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie/outputs/prompt_sensitivity_70b'

with open(ONTOLOGY_FILE) as f:
    ontology = json.load(f)

VALID_ENTITY_TYPES = set(ontology['entity_types'])
VALID_RELATION_NAMES = set(r.lower().strip() for r in ontology['relation_types'])
RELATION_CONSTRAINTS = ontology['relation_constraints']
valid_pairs_by_rel = {}
for rel_name, constraint in RELATION_CONSTRAINTS.items():
    valid_pairs_by_rel[rel_name.lower().strip()] = set(tuple(p) for p in constraint['valid_pairs'])

def normalize_rel(r):
    """Normalize a relation dict to flat format (head_str, tail_str, type, head_type, tail_type)."""
    head = r.get('head', '')
    tail = r.get('tail', '')
    rtype = r.get('type', '')
    if not isinstance(rtype, str):
        rtype = ''
    if isinstance(head, dict):
        head_type = head.get('type', '')
        head = head.get('text', '')
    else:
        head_type = r.get('head_type', '')
    if isinstance(tail, dict):
        tail_type = tail.get('type', '')
        tail = tail.get('text', '')
    else:
        tail_type = r.get('tail_type', '')
    if not isinstance(head, str): head = str(head)
    if not isinstance(tail, str): tail = str(tail)
    if not isinstance(head_type, str): head_type = ''
    if not isinstance(tail_type, str): tail_type = ''
    return head, tail, rtype.lower().strip(), head_type.strip(), tail_type.strip()

def evaluate(input_path, label):
    total_samples = 0
    parse_failures = 0
    total_entities_pred = 0
    total_relations_pred = 0
    et_violations = rv_violations = dr_violations = cf_violations = 0
    entity_tp = entity_fp = entity_fn = 0
    relation_tp = relation_fp = relation_fn = 0
    total_time = 0.0
    time_count = 0
    nested_format_count = 0

    with open(input_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            total_samples += 1
            doc = json.loads(line)
            parsed = doc.get('parsed_output')
            gold_entities = doc.get('gold_entities', [])
            gold_relations = doc.get('gold_relations', [])
            t = doc.get('inference_time_seconds', 0)
            if t:
                total_time += t
                time_count += 1
            if parsed is None or parsed == {}:
                parse_failures += 1
                entity_fn += len(set((e['text'], e['type']) for e in gold_entities))
                relation_fn += len(set((r['head'], r['tail'], r['type'].lower().strip()) for r in gold_relations))
                continue
            pred_entities = [e for e in parsed.get('entities', []) if isinstance(e, dict)]
            pred_relations = [r for r in parsed.get('relations', []) if isinstance(r, dict)]
            total_entities_pred += len(pred_entities)
            total_relations_pred += len(pred_relations)
            for ent in pred_entities:
                etype = ent.get('type', '')
                if isinstance(etype, str) and etype.strip() not in VALID_ENTITY_TYPES:
                    et_violations += 1
            entity_type_map = defaultdict(set)
            for rel in pred_relations:
                head, tail, rel_name, head_type, tail_type = normalize_rel(rel)
                if isinstance(rel.get('head'), dict):
                    nested_format_count += 1
                if head and head_type:
                    entity_type_map[head.lower()].add(head_type)
                if tail and tail_type:
                    entity_type_map[tail.lower()].add(tail_type)
                if rel_name not in VALID_RELATION_NAMES:
                    rv_violations += 1
                    continue
                if rel_name in valid_pairs_by_rel and head_type and tail_type:
                    pair = (head_type, tail_type)
                    if pair not in valid_pairs_by_rel[rel_name]:
                        dr_violations += 1
            for entity_name, types in entity_type_map.items():
                if len(types) > 1:
                    cf_violations += 1
            gold_ent_set = set((e['text'], e['type']) for e in gold_entities)
            pred_ent_set = set()
            for e in pred_entities:
                txt = e.get('text', '')
                tp = e.get('type', '')
                if isinstance(txt, str) and isinstance(tp, str):
                    pred_ent_set.add((txt, tp))
            entity_tp += len(gold_ent_set & pred_ent_set)
            entity_fp += len(pred_ent_set - gold_ent_set)
            entity_fn += len(gold_ent_set - pred_ent_set)
            gold_rel_set = set((r['head'], r['tail'], r['type'].lower().strip()) for r in gold_relations)
            pred_rel_set = set()
            for r in pred_relations:
                h, tl, tp, _, _ = normalize_rel(r)
                pred_rel_set.add((h, tl, tp))
            relation_tp += len(gold_rel_set & pred_rel_set)
            relation_fp += len(pred_rel_set - gold_rel_set)
            relation_fn += len(gold_rel_set - pred_rel_set)

    def prf(tp, fp, fn):
        p = tp / (tp + fp) * 100 if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0.0
        r = tp / (tp + fn) * 100 if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0.0
        f1 = 2 * p * r / (p + r) if (p + r) > 0 else 0.0
        return round(p,2), round(r,2), round(f1,2)

    # DR% only over relations that have type info

    dr_pct = round(dr_violations / total_relations_pred * 100, 2) if total_relations_pred else 0
    cf_pct = round(cf_violations / total_entities_pred * 100, 2) if total_entities_pred else 0
    avg_time = round(total_time / time_count, 3) if time_count else 0

    }
